name: Mida A/B Testing
description: Injects the Mida A/B testing JavaScript snippet into the site.
project_description:
Integrate Mida , a lightweight A/B testing platform, into your Drupal site. Mida lets you A/B test any website easily with visual and code editors, unlimited testing, and seamless GA4 integration.

 Features: 
 
 Easy configuration with your Mida API key 
 Built-in anti-flickering support to prevent content flash during tests 
 Configurable visibility conditions (pages, roles, languages, content types) 
 Asynchronous script loading for optimal performance
